note: [agent-bulk] Verdict on the leading EM shower 7040 (949.6 MeV, 16 seg): leans correct, but I could not settle it, hence unclear. Reading (a) correct: all 16 members lie within 11.2 deg of one axis, one apex at the vertex, the body is continuous 0-55 cm and the rest is the tail of a 950 MeV shower (55 cm is only ~4 X0). Reading (b) over-clustered: the member set has a 21.7 cm gap (76.3 -> 98.0 cm) and then six more stub segments out to 120 cm (88168/88169/44061/87159/49066/87163, 14.2 cm of segment length, all pass3_cone tier 2) that on shw7040-az-055 and az+085 are visibly detached blobs, not part of a continuous body. The images do not separate the two readings and the acceptance plot does not either. HARNESS LIMITATION on this event: the vertex sweep is unusable -- r95 is 424 cm because of a 483 cm through-going muon, so the six vtx-* frames were rendered at +-400 cm and resolve nothing near the star. Every judgement here rests on the shower-framed captures (7040 at +-73 cm, 79136 +-47, 75099 +-62, 72076 +-30). Vertex nevertheless reads sane in those frames: the 483 cm muon 7172 and the 71.6 cm pion 7039 (both correctly left unowned) both start on the star, and 7040/75099/79136/72076 fan out from it. OBSERVATION worth the owner's eye, measured not inferred: six segments -- 72173, 72083, 72084, 72086, 72087, 72082, about 37 cm of cluster-72 skeleton -- are members of BOTH shower 79136 (625.6 MeV, where they sit at 27-29 deg, no tier, added by from_vertices walk_add) AND shower 72076 (127.3 MeV, where they sit at 1.5-9.2 deg, tier 1). Their charge is therefore inside both energy figures. I do not know whether overlapping membership is by design in this reconstruction, so I make no verdict on it. Note the display's own 'in shower' column is first-owner-wins (owner_map), so it shows only 79136 for those six; the per-shower count in cmp_div is what reveals the overlap. Smaller item: 71074 (2.7 cm pdg 13 at 19.4 cm / 5.2 deg, tier 1) is a non-member sitting inside 72076's pass-1 acceptance box -- a small under-clustering of 72076, not marked. No marks recorded on this event. Scope: 4 of 14 showers in scope (7040 949.6, 79136 625.6, 75099 301.2, 72076 127.3 MeV); the other 10 (40057 4.9, 27044 4.7, 37054 3.5, 51068 2.5, 47064 2.5, 24041 2.0, 32049 1.7, 43060 1.2, 50067 0.6, 48065 0.6 MeV) are all under 5 MeV, were skipped by the 20 MeV rule, and I did not look at them. Pi0: no reco pi0 group. The capture's automatic slots priced 7040+79136 at 460.6 MeV (axis convention; the vertex convention returns no chord because 7040 starts on the vertex), and the kine_pio_ BDT feature says 453.9 MeV and does not close with its own formula (525.2). Both members of that pair are vertex-attached or near it (7040 at 0.0 cm, 79136 at 18.0 cm), so neither reads as a converted photon and I propose no pi0 pairing.
